techniques.name: Mystical Palm
techniques.mechanic: Hold use on an ally (or yourself at half rate): heals 1 HP a second per 10 control above 40, 2 chakra a second

techniques.name: Chakra Scalpel
techniques.mechanic: Blades of chakra on the fingers (200 ticks): melee hits ignore armour and leave the target numbed (cut muscles)
techniques.counters: dodge or interrupt the signs; walls block projectiles

techniques.name: Poison Extraction
techniques.mechanic: Draws every poison out of an ally (60 ticks) and gives 400 ticks of immunity
techniques.counters: dodge or interrupt the signs; walls block projectiles

techniques.name: Resuscitation
techniques.mechanic: Revive a downed squadmate at once with 40% health (once per fight per ally)
techniques.counters: dodge or interrupt the signs; walls block projectiles

techniques.name: Strength of a Hundred
techniques.mechanic: A seal stores chakra over days (1% a day, at most 100% of your max). Release it: heal 2 HP every tick-second for 20 s and no technique costs chakra
techniques.counters: dodge or interrupt the signs; walls block projectiles
